item.title: OCaml Weekly News, 04 Aug 2026
item.description:
1. SQLite rewritten in Pure OCaml with Claude Code for use in Mirage Unikernels
  2. New opam packages available : CamlSurf and Gles3
  3. bcfg, a Boringly Simple ConFiGuration format
  4. Introcaml (alpha): Polymorphic Printing and Introspection for OCaml
  5. Learnings from benchmarking OxCaml-flavoured SWAR memchr
  6. OCaml Runtime Meeting: Mon, July 6 @ 10:00 UTC (10:00 London/Cambridge, 11:00 Paris, 7pm Sydney)
